title: feat(c2d4face): cost-2 max≥4 out-face face reverse holds k=1..8
science: Face table for c2d4 (floor 4, cost 2) on B_16(0): axis identical to c2d3's 6,12,18,24,26,28,31,37 but face 4,8,10,12,15,18,21,24, and reverse HOLDS at every k=1..8. The unique clean face table in the band, and the discriminator that selects c2d4 over c2d3/psi/s2 -- all of which fail somewhere. Load-bearing for the band's own choice of terminal candidate.
verdict_pair: reverse=absent face=holds k=1..8, no failure (face bits, not family verdicts)
